description: Executes multiple Trello API GET requests in a single batch operation for efficient bulk data retrieval.

inputSchema.description: Defines the parameters for making a batch GET request to the Trello API.

urls.description: A comma-separated string of Trello API v1 GET routes to be executed in a single batch request. Each route must be relative to the `/1` Trello API base (e.g., `/cards/{idCard}`, `/boards/{idBoard}/lists`) and should not include the `/1` prefix in the individual routes. Trello typically limits this to a maximum of 10 routes per batch call.
urls.title: Urls

inputSchema.title: GetBatchRequest

name: get_batch

GetBatchResponse.description: Array of batch response objects, where each element represents the result of one batched GET request. The Trello batch endpoint allows up to 10 GET requests in a single API call.

batch_results.description: Array of batch response objects, where each element is an object with a single numeric HTTP status code key (e.g., '200', '404', '401'). The value for successful requests (200) is typically an array of objects; error status codes contain string error messages.
batch_results.title: Batch Results
